scope: Frozen assigned titles and complete ItemBodies, matching local source and HTML, receipt metadata, and every receipt-listed screenshot tile. No live routes.

review_method.rendering: All 327 receipt-listed PNG tiles were individually opened with tools.view_image at original resolution; no collage or downscaled substitute was used. Each tile below is attested individually and has a matching observed SHA-256.
review_method.source_snapshot_html: All 175 frozen titles and complete ItemBodies were reviewed against assignment source and corresponding local HTML. Every frozen snapshot hash equals its assigned source hash; every local HTML hash equals its assignment hash.
review_method.boundary: Local-only and read-only audit. No item, application, or publication-status changes.

findings.rationale: The example explicitly defines the six faces of [0,1]^3 by six parameter maps and gives the associated outward oriented area vectors. A labeled cube diagram can make the face-to-map assignments and orientation signs immediately inspectable, which are central to the example’s claim that one presentation is adapted in all three coordinate directions.
findings.diagram_spec: Draw [0,1]^3 in perspective; label its six coordinate faces x±, y±, z± and put outward arrows labelled ±e_x, ±e_y, ±e_z. Pair each face with the corresponding map above or use a compact adjacent legend so parameter order and normal sign remain explicit.
